PDF to Excel

Lift tables and rows into a spreadsheet.

Detect rows and columns from each page and place them into an .xlsx workbook — one sheet per page, with numbers kept numeric where possible.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How PDF to Excel works

  1. Add a PDF containing tables or structured text.
  2. Choose automatic table detection or one row per text line.
  3. Download the ready-to-use Excel workbook.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.
